biocs.name: Conhost Spawning Cmd with Suspicious Args
biocs.description: Detection of conhost.exe spawning cmd.exe with suspicious command-line arguments
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'conhost.exe' and action_process_image_name = 'cmd.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'powershell' or action_process_command_line contains 'iex'
